Why is Saka in the Starting XI with an Injury Flag?

Saka carries an official 50% injury flag (Thigh). The model factored this in by discounting his projected minutes from 85 to 42.6 mins (47% xStart), which halved his projection to 3.95 pts. Even discounted, 3.95 pts is higher than 1st bench option Barry (3.48 pts). In FPL, starting Saka with Barry as 1st sub provides maximum expected value: if Saka is cleared to play, you reap his high upside; if he misses out completely (0 mins), Barry automatically substitutes in.
